The force of the negative case in a sūtra is that of the phrase 'in the place of', when no special rules qualify the sense of Genitive 6th-Case.

Terms:

The word पति when used in connection with a noun ending in the 6th or genitive case, is घि , optionally, in the छन्दस् (Veda).

Terms: घि पति

A word ending with a sixth case-affix is compounded with a case-inflected word with which it is in construction and the compound is तत्-पुरुष।

Terms: समास-तत्-पुरुष

The 6th-Case-affix is used after a noun implying the cause of an action, when the word हेतु is used along with such a word.

Terms: विभक्ति-6
The 6th-Case-affix is used when used in connection with words ending with affixes having the sense of the affix अतसुच -- दक्षिणोत्तराभ्यामतसुच्

.

Terms: विभक्ति-6

The 6th-Case-affix is used (as well as the 7th), when disregard is to be shown after that by whose action the time of another action is indicated.

Terms: विभक्ति-6, 7

The 6th-Case-affix is used in the remaining cases, that is to say, where there is a sense, such as the relation between property and its owner etc. different from that of a word related to a verb and from that of a Nominal-stem.

Terms: विभक्ति-6

The affix अण् comes after the name of a full-moon-night to denote the division of time in which the night falls.

Terms: अण्
The affix अण् -- प्राग्दीव्यतोऽण्

, is added to the name of a deity when something is to be spoken of as his.

Terms: अण्

The anomalously formed word षष्टिकाः has the meaning of 'what are matured in six nights'.

Terms:

After the words षष्ठी etc. when no other Numeral precedes them; तमट् is always the augment of डट्।

Terms: डट् and (तमट्)

The affix कन् comes in the sense of 'to supply richly with it' after the word सस्य being in the Instrumental -3rd case in construction.

Terms: कन्

The affixes ञ (अ) and अन् after 1. षष्ठ and 2. अष्ठम when a 'part' is meant, but not in the छन्दस् (Vedas).

Terms: ञ (अ) and अन्

After a प्रातिपदिक (Nominal Stem) ending in the Genitive 6th-Case comes the affix रूप्य and also चरट् in the sense of 'having belonged formerly to somebody'.

Terms: रूप्य

The affixes स and स्नौ come after मृद् when it means 'excellence'.

Terms: स and स्नौ

The affix तसि comes optionally after a word ending in the Genitive 6th-Case when the sense is that of a party-name or function.

Terms: तसि

The word राजन् ending in Genitive 6th-Case optionally retains its original accent before the word प्रत्येनस्।

Terms: समास accent

The Genitive 6th-Case-affix is retained when the compound expresses an 'affront or insult'.

Terms: विभक्ति-Non-elision

Before the Aorist in अङ् and before an affix beginning with a consonant having an indicatory क् or ङ् there is the substitution of ई for the vowel of शास्।

Terms: अभीय Rules

न् is substituted for स् of अस् the affix of the Accusative -2nd case plural after the अङ्ग (stems) युष्मद् and अस्मद्।

Terms: Some substitution

In the छन्दस् (Vedas) ससूव is irregularly formed in the लिट् (Perfect Tense).

Terms: Reduplicate

For the final स् and for the ष् of ससजुष् is substituted रु , at the end of a word.

Terms: रु substitution

For the विसर्ग of the Genitive 6th-Case there is substituted स् in the छन्दस् (Vedas) before 1. पति 2. पुत्र 3. पृष्ठ 4. पार 5. पद 6. पयस् and 7. पोष।

Terms: विसर्ग सन्धि

ष् is substituted for the स् of 1. शास् 2. वस् 'to dwell' and 3. घस् when it is preceded by an इण् vowel or a guttural.

Terms: ष् change

in the room of श preceded by a surd Mute, there is optionally the letter छ् when a vowel or य, व or र follows such श।
